title_original: The Film Comment Podcast: John Early on Maddie’s Secret
excerpt_original: The comedian and actor discusses his directorial debut, a wonderfully original send-up of TV movies, erotic thrillers, and more

blocks.text: Listeners might know John Early as a (very funny) comedian, actor, Toni Collette–superfan, and more—but last year at the Toronto International Film Festival, he debuted a new role: auteur. His directorial debut, Maddie’s Secret , takes cues from TV movies, PSAs, erotic thrillers, internet videos, Paul Verhoeven’s Showgirls , and other high-low cultural touchstones to craft a movie that, despite all these influences and parodic touches, feels wonderfully original and earnest. Early plays the titular Maddie, a food influencer who struggles with bulimia, with sincere commitment, somehow walking the tightrope between camp, laugh-out-loud wit, and a profound empathy.
Maddie’s Secret opens in cinemas on June 19. Keep your ears open for Part 2 of this conversation, which will be dropping soon as an exclusive for Film Comment subscribers.
